name: contract
quote:
- name: stg_tiktok_ads__advertiser
      description: "Cleaned advertiser master data with normalized contact fields and type-safe numeric conversions."
      source_table: raw.tiktok_advertiser_data
      columns:
        - name: source_relation
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: advertiser_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: address
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: balance
          data_type: DOUBLE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "balance is numeric"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: company
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: contacter
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: country
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: currency
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: description
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: email
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "email normalized to lowercase and trimmed"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "email matches standard pattern (local@domain.tld)"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: industry
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: language
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: advertiser_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "name trimmed"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "name length between 3 and 100 and only alphanumeric plus spaces"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: cellphone_number
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "strip non-digit characters except leading '+'"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "must conform to E.164 format"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: telephone_number
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: timezone
          data_type: VARCHAR
